content_sections.heading: About MGUG
content_sections.text: Mahayogi Gorakhnath University, Gorakhpur, is a multidisciplinary university with a 200+ acre campus at Balapar, Gorakhpur. It offers higher education in fields including Medicine, Ayurveda, Pharmacy, Nursing, Agriculture, Allied Health Sciences, and Management & Commerce. The campus is home to an upcoming multi-specialty hospital with 1,800 beds, and two functional multispecialty hospitals in Gorakhpur have 600+ beds (Gorakhnath Chikitsalaya) and 200+ beds (Mahayogi Gorakhnath Chikitsalaya).

content_sections.heading: MGUG X-Ray Technician Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Diploma/Degree in Radiography, X-Ray Technology, Medical Imaging Technology, or an equivalent qualification from a recognized institution. Experience in operating X-Ray equipment in a hospital or healthcare institution. Sound knowledge of X-Ray imaging procedures, equipment handling, and patient positioning. Ability to assist doctors in conducting diagnostic X-Ray examinations and ensure quality imaging. Knowledge of radiation safety, infection control practices, and biomedical waste management. Ability to maintain proper patient records, imaging registers, and other relevant documentation. Candidates with relevant experience in a hospital or diagnostic imaging department will be preferred. Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary healthcare team. Ability to work efficiently under pressure and during emergency situations, including rotational shifts. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of this post.

faq.question: Q1. Which hospital is hiring X-Ray Technicians?
faq.answer: Mahayogi Gorakhnath Hospital, Gorakhpur, is inviting the applications under the aegis of the University.

faq.question: Q2. Is experience compulsory for this post?
faq.answer: Yes. Experience in operating X-Ray equipment in a hospital or healthcare institution is listed under the essential requirements.

faq.question: Q3. What gets preference in the application?
faq.answer: Candidates with relevant experience in a hospital or diagnostic imaging department will be preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What should the application include?
faq.answer: Send a detailed resume, supporting documents and a cover letter.

faq.question: Q5. What subject line should the email carry?
faq.answer: The subject of the email should be "Application for X-Ray Technician".

faq.question: Q6. How is the salary decided?
faq.answer: The notice says salary shall be commensurate with qualification, skills and experience as per University rules.

faq.question: Q7. What technical knowledge should a candidate have?
faq.answer: The notice asks for knowledge of X-Ray imaging procedures, equipment handling and patient positioning, as well as radiation safety, infection control practices and biomedical waste management.

faq.question: Q8. Could the University advertise this post again?
faq.answer: If any vacancy arises after a particular post is filled, the notice says that vacancy shall be advertised.
